unrecoverableState.name: NARRATED_UNMEASURED
unrecoverableState.definition: No seal, no failure line, vagueness carried overnight.
unrecoverableState.recovery: Write the failure line late and mark it late.

sharedLaw.streakLaw: Sealed and failed-measured days are recorded side by side; the measurement is the streak.
sharedLaw.morningCommandEditPolicy: Command may not be edited on the day it runs (editing is D-002).
sharedLaw.protocolDocumentEditPolicy: Refining any protocol document instead of executing it is always the trap's first form (D-002).

carriedDoctrines.name: NARRATIVE COMPLETION
carriedDoctrines.proposition: SELF experiences the feeling of a completed future before material completion, and the feeling substitutes for the act.
carriedDoctrines.tell: The win-feeling spikes right after friction and right after small wins.
carriedDoctrines.instrument: Daily Narrative Completion Check with timestamp.

carriedDoctrines.name: DESIGN SUBSTITUTION
carriedDoctrines.proposition: Under friction, SELF escapes into architecture — planning, improving, refining the protocol itself.
carriedDoctrines.instrument: Design-instead-of-do component of the leak tally; standing ban on editing protocol documents on the day they run.

carriedDoctrines.name: AUTHORSHIP
carriedDoctrines.proposition: SELF completes self-authored structures at a higher rate than imposed ones.
carriedDoctrines.falsificationRule: Low completion across BOTH self-authored and imposed structures falsifies: mechanism is friction-avoidance, not autonomy. Rewrite the doctrine.
carriedDoctrines.instrument: Live structure log: Time / Structure / Self-authored-Imposed / Completed-Abandoned / feeling one second before abandonment.

days.title: THE RAW STATE

doctrine.name: VAGUENESS AS SHELTER
doctrine.proposition: SELF keeps facts unmeasured because precision creates obligation.
doctrine.prediction: Resistance clusters on exactly the fields whose numbers SELF already roughly knows.
doctrine.falsificationRule: Every field fills with exact values at equal speed and the approximation tally stays near zero — vagueness was a data-access problem, not a shelter. Rewrite it.

trap.name: THE ELOQUENT CONFESSION
trap.definition: Vagueness upgraded to poetry — writing something deep and true-sounding about the situation instead of writing the number.
detectionSignals: adjectives where numbers should be (heavy, complicated, roughly, I think around)
approximation for a value retrievable in under two minutes
writing about the sheet instead of into it
surrendered phrases
trap.runtimeResponse: That statement describes intensity, not position. Enter one exact value, one source artifact, or explicitly mark the field MISSING with a retrieval date.

surrenderedPhrases: I know I can do more.
A lot has been going on.

definitionOfDone: Reality Position Sheet has zero empty fields — every field carries an exact value or 'MISSING — retrieval date'
Exposure artifact exists and is attached to the record
Every number came from a source (statement, screenshot, export) — not from memory
Fact/Story split (Station 3) is complete
completionStatements: I did not expose the raw state.
failureConditions: No artifact named — the day does not start
Incomplete sheet with a beautiful reflection attached

stations.name: THE SYSTEM DUMP
stations.law: Each answer must contain a number, a name, or a date.

stations.name: THE REALITY POSITION SHEET
stations.law: 15 fields; exact value + source artifact + verified date; MISSING-with-retrieval-date lawful, '~' is not; fill order logged.

stations.name: FACT / STORY SPLIT
stations.law: Three verbatim statements classified FACT (has an artifact) or STORY (has a vibe), with the fact each story conceals.

materialAction.name: THE EXPOSURE
materialAction.requirement: Attach one real artifact to the record.

tally.label: approximation
tally.countsAs: every ~, roughly, about, I think, or surrendered phrase for a value retrievable in under two minutes

mirror.question: What did it cost you to not know that number until today — and who has been making decisions with it while you weren't looking?

requiredStems: The number I most did not want to write down was… and the story I had been using to avoid it was…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: Filling out a sheet can feel like fixing a life. It isn't. The timestamp is the tell.

seal.discomfortThresholdNote: under 7 = you measured the parts that were already safe to see
seal.sealLaw: I cannot command a reality I refuse to measure.

doctrine.name: AVOIDED REVOCATION
doctrine.proposition: Extraction persists not because it is hidden but because revocation costs a confrontation SELF avoids.
doctrine.prediction: SELF can name its heaviest extraction before any mapping (the Gate proves this).
doctrine.falsificationRule: The map genuinely surprises SELF about its heaviest extraction — the mechanism is visibility, not avoidance. Rewrite it.

trap.name: THE MISSING ROW
trap.definition: The map fills with everything except the one access SELF is afraid to name; extraction mapping without that row is a grievance inventory.
trap.secondHead: MORAL ACCOUNTING — cataloguing who takes becomes the day's product; a map of thieves changes nothing, a changed lock does.
detectionSignals: steering around a name
map full of small extractions only
resentment presenting as clarity
trap.runtimeResponse: The audit is not 'is the map full?' It is 'who is absent from it?' Write the row.

gate.prompt: The access I already know I will revoke today is:
gate.gateLaw: You knew one before the map existed. If the Gate needed the map, the Gate would be research — and research is banned as a Gate verb.
definitionOfDone: The revocation executed today — cancelled, declined, moved, stated, blocked
Evidence exists (confirmation screen, sent message, changed permission, calendar block)
The Extraction Graph has a verdict in every row
completionStatements: I did not revoke the access.
failureConditions: No revocation named — the day does not start
A full map with no revocation

openingDebt.resolutionRequirement: Day 1 sealed or failure line written ('I protected field X'). Ambiguous yesterday blocks the day.

stations.name: THE EXTRACTION SWEEP
stations.law: Six categories (economic, attention, emotional, labor, identity, ambition); at least one honest entry per category or written 'none found — checked'.

stations.name: THE EXTRACTION GRAPH
stations.law: Every source gets a full row; every row a verdict (TERMINATE/RENEGOTIATE/CONTAIN/RETAIN); RETAIN must state the proportionate return; mandatory absence audit.

stations.name: THE REVOCATION
stations.law: Not the largest extraction — the one that proves the node can revoke access. Cost logged as feeling, not reason.

tally.label: virtue-word
tally.countsAs: every time a drain gets defended with loyalty, family, support, 'they need me', 'it's fine', 'it's not that deep'

mirror.question: Read the graph. Is the heaviest name from yesterday's sheet on it? If not — is their absence data, or accident? Which recurring expense on this map exists because a recurring decision has not been made — and what is the decision?

requiredStems: The access I revoked today cost me… The access I did not revoke is… and what it buys the other party is…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: Finishing the map can feel like closing the leaks. A mapped leak still leaks.

seal.discomfortThresholdNote: under 7 = you revoked something that cost nothing
seal.failureMessage: I mapped and did not move.
seal.sealLaw: Access to SELF is not inherited. It is governed.

doctrine.name: DISCOUNTED CAPACITY
doctrine.proposition: SELF underweights verified wins to preserve 'potential' status, because proven capacity is billable and potential owes nothing.
doctrine.prediction: The CLAIM step (pricing, witness, publishing) produces more resistance than the RECALL step.
doctrine.falsificationRule: Recall is the hard part and claiming is easy — the mechanism is memory weighting, not obligation avoidance. Rewrite it.

trap.name: THE HUMBLE DISCOUNT
trap.definition: 'That doesn't really count' wearing the face of honesty — discounting keeps SELF in potential status, and potential owes nothing.
trap.secondHead: THE INFLATED LEDGER — padding the record with claims no witness can confirm. Both heads keep the record unusable.
detectionSignals: doesn't really count
anyone could have done that
it was luck
the conditions were easy
it wasn't finished/paid/public
trap.runtimeResponse: The WITNESS column kills both heads: an entry is either witnessed or marked UNWITNESSED — no silent middle. The words 'doesn't really count' are a tally, not a judgment.

gate.prompt: The capability that gets a price, a page, or a buyer contact today is:
definitionOfDone: The Force Ledger holds at least 5 complete entries
The conversion artifact exists — a price named, a page live, or a buyer contacted
Evidence exists (link, sent messages, signed doc, published post)
completionStatements: I did not convert the capability.
failureConditions: No capability named — the day does not start
A beautiful ledger with nothing priced

openingDebt.resolutionRequirement: Day 2 sealed or failure line written. Memo recorded, verdicts filled, or failure line written and signed.

stations.name: THE FORCE LEDGER
stations.law: Minimum 5 entries, every field; external witness named or entry marked UNWITNESSED — no silent middle.

stations.name: THE UNBILLED INVENTORY
stations.law: Count entries marked NO or PARTIAL; pick the conversion target (strongest witness, weakest price).

stations.name: THE CONVERSION
stations.law: Convert the Gate capability into a live offer, asset, or command; price or claim in numbers or exact words; feeling one second before publishing.

materialAction.name: THE CONVERSION
materialAction.requirement: One capability converted into a live offer with evidence.

tally.label: discount
tally.countsAs: every 'doesn't really count', 'anyone could', 'just luck', 'the bar was low', 'it wasn't a big deal' — the discount spikes when an entry gets close to billable

mirror.question: If a stranger woke up tomorrow holding your Force Ledger — same evidence, same witnesses — what would they charge for it by Friday? Write the number. Now: what has the discount been buying you that the invoice wouldn't?

requiredStems: The entry in my Force Ledger I keep trying to shrink is… and if I stop shrinking it, I would have to…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: A finished ledger can feel like a funded business. It's a list until the offer ships.

requirements: Force Ledger (>=5 complete entries, witness column honest)
seal.discomfortThresholdNote: under 7 = you priced the capability you were least afraid to claim
seal.failureMessage: I proved it and kept it unpriced.
seal.sealLaw: Potential is capacity without witness. My capacity now has evidence.

doctrine.name: SHAME SETTLEMENT
doctrine.proposition: SELF uses guilt as currency — feeling bad discharges the debt so repair never executes.
doctrine.prediction: Shame arrives before or instead of the repair action, and repair gets postponed once shame is felt.
doctrine.falsificationRule: The repair executes within 24 hours without a shame spike — the betrayals were scheduling failures, not settlement structures. Rewrite it.

trap.name: THE SHAME PAYMENT
trap.definition: Feeling bad presents itself as accountability — it hurts enough to feel like justice and costs nothing structural. Guilt discharges the debt emotionally so the repair never executes.
trap.secondHead: THE CONFESSION LOOP — confessing the same betrayal eloquently for the nth time; at n>=2 the confession IS the betrayal, renewed.
detectionSignals: guilt arriving and offering to settle
repair stalling after a shame spike
repeat confession of an already-confessed betrayal
trap.runtimeResponse: The audit accepts exactly one currency: repair executed. Feelings are not legal tender here. Tally it, timestamp it, return to the artifact.

gate.prompt: The betrayal I will repair within 24 hours is: / The repair artifact is:
gate.gateLaw: An apology is not an artifact. A repair is.
definitionOfDone: The Betrayal Record holds at least 3 complete rows
The Gate repair executed — the artifact exists inside the 24-hour window
At least 3 SELF SAID / SELF DID side-by-sides written verbatim
completionStatements: I did not repair the betrayal.
failureConditions: No betrayal + artifact named — the day does not start
A record full of contradictions and zero repairs

openingDebt.resolutionRequirement: Day 3 sealed or failure line written. If Day 3 sealed, read the warning twice: the day after a win is the highest-risk day. A win is a down payment, not permission.

stations.name: THE BETRAYAL SWEEP
stations.law: Eight categories (declaration, boundary, evidence, time, capital, creation, relational, body); at least one honest entry each or written 'none found — checked'.

stations.name: THE BETRAYAL RECORD
stations.law: Minimum 3 rows, every field, including an executable REPAIR COMMAND with an artifact.

stations.name: SELF SAID / SELF DID
stations.law: Minimum 3 side-by-sides, verbatim with source and date. No shame language. Only constitutional contradiction. The gap needs no adjectives.

stations.name: THE REPAIR
stations.law: Execute the Gate repair inside 24h; clock start and artifact-landed timestamps logged; shame arrival position logged (before/during/instead/didn't).

materialAction.name: THE REPAIR
materialAction.requirement: One betrayal repaired within 24 hours with an artifact.

tally.label: shame-hit
tally.countsAs: every time feeling bad arrives and offers to settle the account; log the hour and what the repair-move would have been. The shame-hit to repair-move ratio is the day's real finding.

mirror.question: Which betrayal did you leave off the record because repairing it would require disappointing someone specific? Name the person. Diffuse guilt can't be discharged; one named person can actually be served, or actually be disappointed. Which are you carrying?

requiredStems: The betrayal I repaired today was… What I wanted to do instead of repairing it was feel…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: Feeling forgiven is the day's counterfeit win. Forgiveness without the artifact is D-001 in a robe.

seal.discomfortThresholdNote: under 7 = you audited a betrayal you'd already forgiven
seal.failureMessage: I confessed and did not repair.
seal.sealLaw: A law I repeatedly violate is not yet law.

doctrine.name: ALLOCATION DRIFT
doctrine.proposition: Resources without a constitutional destination are allocated by pressure — by whoever or whatever applies force first.
doctrine.prediction: SELF designs the allocation and defers the transfer.
doctrine.falsificationRule: The transfer executes same-day alongside the design — the drift was absence of structure, now corrected; the doctrine survives as environmental, not psychological. Record the rewrite.

trap.name: THE BEAUTIFUL TREASURY
trap.definition: Building the allocation system — categories, labels, cleaner app — with total sincerity, and scheduling the actual transfer for 'when things settle'. Reorganizing, not repossessing.
detectionSignals: every resource categorized, none changed hands
scheduled repossession
perfecting structure at transfer time
trap.runtimeResponse: Scheduled repossession is continued occupancy. A plan to move money is not moved money. Tally it, timestamp it, move the resource.

gate.prompt: The resource that moves today is: / FROM (current owner in practice): / TO (constitutional destination):
definitionOfDone: The Treasury & Authority Map is complete for all five resources
The capital split carries real numbers — or the single word UNSPLIT, signed
The Gate transfer executed today, with evidence
failureConditions: No resource + endpoints named — the day does not start
A completed map with an unexecuted transfer

openingDebt.resolutionRequirement: Day 4 sealed or failure line written. Repair unverified, memo short, or boxes signed empty = ambiguous = blocked.

stations.name: THE TREASURY & AUTHORITY MAP
stations.law: Five resources (attention, time, capital, access, decision authority); every row every field; 'current owner in practice' is whoever actually decides.

stations.name: THE CAPITAL DOCTRINE
stations.law: Split real numbers across operating/reserve/build/speculative/reward — or write the one lawful word UNSPLIT and sign it. An unsigned blank is a leak; a signed UNSPLIT is a measurement.

stations.name: THE TRANSFER
stations.law: Execute the Gate transfer; log evidence and the first pressure against the new allocation (held/folded).

tally.label: later
tally.countsAs: every 'when things settle', 'next month', 'after this week clears', 'once X happens' — every later is a lease renewal for the current occupant; laters cluster right before transfers

mirror.question: Who allocated your last unallocated hour, and your last unallocated dollar — you, or whoever applied pressure first? Name the allocator. Is that the officer you meant to appoint?

requiredStems: What I moved today was… What I only planned to move was… The difference between those two lists is…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: A finished map feels like a funded treasury. Categories are not custody.

requirements: Treasury & Authority Map (five resources, every field)
seal.discomfortThresholdNote: under 7 = you moved what nobody would notice
seal.failureMessage: I categorized and did not move.
seal.sealLaw: What I do not allocate will be allocated by pressure.

doctrine.name: REVERSIBILITY PREFERENCE
doctrine.proposition: SELF selects changes that can be undone unseen, because witnessed, irreversible change can fail publicly.
doctrine.prediction: Mutation candidates get privately drafted and publicly withheld; 'it needs to be better first' appears.
doctrine.falsificationRule: The mutation ships witnessed and hard-to-reverse before evening — the preference is broken or absent. Record it.

trap.name: THE PRIVATE MUTATION
trap.definition: Doing real work and keeping it invisible — writing the offer, not publishing it; drafting the message, not sending it. Unseen changes can't be judged, so they can't fail — and so they aren't evidence.
trap.secondHead: THE WORTHINESS DELAY — 'it needs to be better before anyone sees it.' The send button is the mutation; everything before it is rehearsal, and that budget is spent.
detectionSignals: pull toward the quietly reversible candidate
flinch at the moment a witness would enter
worthiness delays clustering at the send boundary, never at the build
trap.runtimeResponse: If no one could dispute your evidence, it is not evidence yet. The Gate asks 'why is it hard to reverse' to catch the pull at selection time, not at midnight.

gate.prompt: The mutation artifact that will exist by midnight is: / Its witness is: / Why it is hard to reverse:
definitionOfDone: The Mutation Packet complete before execution — evidence standard declared in advance
The external state changed by midnight — checkable by someone other than SELF
Before/after evidence captured to the packet's declared standard
The witness can confirm the new state exists
failureConditions: No artifact + witness + irreversibility line — the day does not start
A perfect packet with an unchanged world

openingDebt.resolutionRequirement: Day 5 sealed or failure line written. Every debt carried past tonight arrives in tomorrow's docket as an UNPROVEN exhibit.

stations.name: THE CANDIDATE BOARD
stations.law: Seven mutation classes (economic, structural, relational, creative, environmental, identity, legal/admin); at least one live candidate per applicable class; selection audit logs the candidate NOT chosen and why.

stations.name: THE MUTATION PACKET
stations.law: Complete before execution; evidence standard declared in advance so tonight's evidence can't be negotiated downward; rollback cost must be > 0; formula: OLD STATE -> AUTHORIZED ACTION -> NEW MATERIAL STATE -> EVIDENCE.

stations.name: EXECUTION + EVIDENCE
stations.law: Execution hour, before/after evidence, witness confirmation (or scheduled confirmation date), feeling one second before the send.

materialAction.name: THE MUTATION
materialAction.requirement: External state change by midnight, witnessed, to the pre-declared evidence standard.

tally.label: worthiness
tally.countsAs: every 'needs to be better first', 'not ready for eyes yet', 'I'll send the improved version', every flinch at the witness boundary

mirror.question: Both of those happened where others could check them. What is different about today's candidate that made you consider doing it in private — the stakes, or the audience? And if the audience is the variable: who exactly are you keeping from watching?

requiredStems: The moment before I made it public, I felt… If this mutation fails in front of witnesses, the actual cost is…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: A completed packet feels like a completed mutation. The packet is paperwork until the state changes.

seal.failureMessage: I rehearsed and did not ship.
seal.sealLaw: Reality does not record intention. It records state change.

days.title: THE EVIDENCE COURT

doctrine.name: NARRATIVE SENTENCING
doctrine.proposition: SELF converts a mixed evidence record into a clean story — triumph or indictment — because stories end and records carry.
doctrine.prediction: Pressure to grade all declarations in the same direction.
doctrine.falsificationRule: The verdict sheet lands mixed, every verdict carries a citation, and the thirty-day mission is built from PARTIALLY PROVEN items — sentencing was resisted. Record it.

trap.name: THE CLEAN STORY
trap.definition: The last lie of the week is the summary. Two escapes: the transformation story ('I'm a different person now' — arrival ends the accounting) and the indictment story ('this proved nothing' — total failure dismisses the record). Both mean the record doesn't have to be carried.
detectionSignals: all verdicts in one direction
urge to summarize the week as triumph or indictment
story urges spiking near verdicts that hurt
trap.runtimeResponse: PARTIALLY PROVEN is not a lesser grade — it is the most honest verdict available on day seven and the only one that produces a real thirty-day mission. A one-directional verdict sheet gets re-tried with the trap in view.

gate.prompt: The docket — assembled before the court convenes. The court tries declarations, not days.
definitionOfDone: Docket complete — all exhibits attached
Minimum 5 declarations docketed (every claim SELF made in writing this week)
Every verdict carries an exhibit citation
One constitutional law with detection method
Thirty-day mission, all nine fields with numbers/dates
Node witness statement collected (unflattered)
completionStatements: The court sat on the full docket.
failureConditions: Incomplete docket — the court does not convene; an unconvened court is a failed Day 7, write the line

days.verdictLaw: A verdict without an exhibit reference is void. All-one-direction distributions get re-tried.

openingDebt.resolutionRequirement: ALL days 1-6 stand as Sealed or Failed-Measured in writing. Debts payable this morning get paid; debts that cannot enter the docket as exhibits, not excuses.

stations.name: THE PRESENTATION
stations.law: Seven lines filled from exhibits only — no memory, no vibe (claimed/measured/interrupted/proved/repossessed/mutated/unresolved).

stations.name: THE TRIAL
stations.law: Every docketed declaration gets exactly one verdict with a citation; distribution check; cross-examination answered from exhibits.

stations.name: THE GENESIS VERDICT
stations.law: Five statuses (capability, execution, authority, risk, coherence), one line each, present tense, evidence-cited.

stations.name: THE CONSTITUTIONAL LAW
stations.law: One law enters the 365-Day Journey. Executable, checkable, violable — otherwise it is a mood. Detection method and cadence named.

stations.name: THE THIRTY-DAY MISSION
stations.law: Built from the PARTIALLY PROVEN rows; every one of nine fields carries a number or a date.

stations.name: THE NODE WITNESS
stations.law: A person from the Genesis circle confirms one observable shift. Not praise. Flattery voids the statement (covenant clause 9).

materialAction.name: THE SENTENCING
materialAction.requirement: Sentencing on evidence only — verdicts with citations, one law, one mission with numbers.

tally.label: story
tally.countsAs: every urge to summarize the week as triumph or indictment — both directions count; story urges spike near verdicts that hurt

mirror.question: Which verdict are you tempted to argue with? Write it. That is the one to read twice — the argument is coming from the identity the evidence didn't support. What does that identity lose when the verdict stands?

requiredStems: The verdict I wanted was… The verdict the evidence permits is… The law I will actually keep is…

questions: Did I feel a future win before earning it today?
If yes — what, and at what hour?
narrativeCheck.refusalRule: Day 7's counterfeit is graduation. The court is not a ceremony.

requirements: Court sat on the full docket
Every verdict carries an exhibit citation
seal.discomfortThresholdNote: under 7 = the court flattered the defendant
